qe: When the British government made its initial decision to partition Bengal public in December 1903, what structural composition was proposed for the western province?
qh: जब ब्रिटिश सरकार ने दिसंबर 1903 में बंगाल के विभाजन के अपने प्रारंभिक निर्णय को सार्वजनिक किया, तो पश्चिमी प्रांत के लिए क्या संरचनात्मक संयोजन प्रस्तावित किया गया था?
o: Western Bengal along with the provinces of Bihar and Orissa
Bengal proper combined exclusively with the Assam valley
Calcutta grouped with the eastern districts of Dacca and Chittagong
Western Bengal merged entirely into the Central Provinces layout
e: Detailed Explanation: The initial partition blueprint made public in December 1903 split the territory into two administrative setups: one was 'Bengal' comprising Western Bengal as well as the provinces of Bihar and Orissa, and the other was 'Eastern Bengal and Assam'.

qe: What was the total population parameter of undivided Bengal in 1903, which the colonial government officially cited as too vast to be administered efficiently by a single baseline framework?
qh: 1903 में अविभाजित बंगाल की कुल जनसंख्या का पैमाना क्या था, जिसे औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने आधिकारिक तौर पर एक ही प्रशासनिक ढांचे द्वारा कुशलतापूर्वक प्रबंधित करने के लिए बहुत विशाल बताया था?
o: 78 million
54 million
31 million
17 million
e: Detailed Explanation: The official justification provided by the British government for the partition plan was administrative necessity. They stated that Bengal, with a massive population of 78 million (roughly one-fourth of the entire population of British India), had become too large to be governed efficiently.

qe: The British partition plan strategically aimed to reduce native Bengalis to a minority within Bengal proper by balancing them against which linguistic majorities?
qh: ब्रिटिश विभाजन योजना का रणनीतिक उद्देश्य मूल बंगालियों को किस भाषाई बहुमत के सामने संतुलित करके खुद बंगाल के भीतर ही अल्पसंख्यक बनाना था?
o: Hindi and Oriya speakers tracking 37 million
Assamese and Santhali speakers accumulating 54 million
Urdu and Punjabi linguistic populations hitting 31 million
Telugu and Marathi speaking communities forming 17 million
e: Detailed Explanation: The real motive was to weaken Bengal, the nerve center of Indian nationalism. It sought to divide the population linguistically, reducing the Bengalis to a minority within their own province by grouping 17 million Bengali speakers with 37 million Hindi and Oriya speakers in the western half.

qe: Under the religious division metrics engineered by the partition, what was the estimated demographic layout designed for the western half of Bengal?
qh: विभाजन द्वारा तैयार किए गए धार्मिक विभाजन के मानकों के तहत, बंगाल के पश्चिमी हिस्से के लिए अनुमानित जनसांख्यिकीय संरचना क्या तय की गई थी?
o: A Hindu majority area with 42 million out of a total 54 million
A Muslim majority area containing 18 million out of 31 million
An equal baseline balance of 17 million Hindus and 17 million Muslims
A Buddhist dominated province tracking close to 78 million residents
e: Detailed Explanation: Religiously, the partition plan structured the western half as a Hindu-majority zone containing 42 million Hindus out of a total population of 54 million, while the eastern half was designed as a Muslim-majority province.

qe: According to the colonial religious demographic mapping, the newly proposed province of Eastern Bengal and Assam was structured to have what specific communal majority?
qh: औपनिवेशिक धार्मिक जनसांख्यिकीय मानचित्रण के अनुसार, पूर्वी बंगाल और असम के नए प्रस्तावित प्रांत को किस विशिष्ट सांप्रदायिक बहुमत के लिए तैयार किया गया था?
o: A Muslim majority area with 18 million out of a total of 31 million
A Hindu majority block capturing 42 million out of 54 million
An absolute animist majority tracking near 78 million individuals
A Christian dominated tribal belt managed entirely by direct jurisdiction
e: Detailed Explanation: The eastern province, designated as Eastern Bengal and Assam with Dacca as its capital, was structured to have a distinct Muslim majority consisting of 18 million Muslims out of a total population of 31 million.

qe: Which British Home Secretary to the Government of India recorded a note in 1904 stating: 'Bengal united is a power. Bengal divided will pull in several different ways... One of our main objects is to split up... opponents to our rule.'?
qh: भारत सरकार के किस ब्रिटिश गृह सचिव ने 1904 में एक नोट में लिखा था: 'संयुक्त बंगाल एक शक्ति है। विभाजित बंगाल कई अलग-अलग तरीकों से खींचेगा... हमारा मुख्य उद्देश्य हमारे शासन के विरोधियों को विभाजित करना है।'?
o: Risley
Curzon
Wellesley
Adams
e: Detailed Explanation: Herbert Hope Risley, the Home Secretary to the Government of India, candidly documented the true political motive of the partition plan in his official minutes in 1904, explicitly stating that the goal was to split up a solid body of nationalist opponents.

qe: Who among the following triplet of early nationalist leaders spearheaded the anti-partition campaign under the Moderate methodology during the initial phase between 1903 and 1905?
qh: 1903 और 1905 के बीच प्रारंभिक चरण के दौरान नरमपंथी कार्यप्रणाली के तहत विभाजन-विरोधी अभियान का नेतृत्व निम्नलिखित में से किस शुरुआती राष्ट्रवादी नेता की त्रिमूर्ति ने किया था?
o: Surendranath Banerjea, K.K. Mitra, and Prithwishchandra Ray
Bal Gangadhar Tilak, Lala Lajpat Rai, and Bipin Chandra Pal
Aurobindo Ghosh, Ajit Singh, and Syed Haider Raza
Dadabhai Naoroji, Dinshaw Wacha, and W.C. Bonnerjee
e: Detailed Explanation: During the initial phase (1903–1905), leadership was firmly held by the Moderates, specifically Surendranath Banerjea, K.K. Mitra, and Prithwishchandra Ray, who relied on constitutional agitation methods.

qe: The early anti-partition agitation launched by the Moderate leadership between 1903 and 1905 relied heavily on which communicative tool to generate public opinion?
qh: 1903 और 1905 के बीच नरमपंथी नेतृत्व द्वारा शुरू किए गए शुरुआती विभाजन-विरोधी आंदोलन ने जनमत तैयार करने के लिए मुख्य रूप से किस संचार साधन पर भरोसा किया?
o: Propaganda through newspapers such as Hitabadi, Sanjibani, and Bengalee
Organizing secret underground revolutionary parameter tracking societies
The total structural boycott of all provincial legislative councils instantly
Launching an armed paramilitary movement armed with traditional clubs
e: Detailed Explanation: The Moderate methodology was focused on creating educated public opinion in India and England. For this propaganda, they continuously utilized influential newspapers like Hitabadi, Sanjibani, and Bengalee.

qe: In which month and year did the colonial government officially ignore public opposition and formally announce the implementation of the partition of Bengal, triggering immediate local protest pledges?
qh: किस महीने और वर्ष में औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने आधिकारिक तौर पर जनविरोध की अनदेखी की और औपचारिक रूप से बंगाल के विभाजन के कार्यान्वयन की घोषणा की, जिससे तत्काल स्थानीय विरोध प्रदर्शन शुरू हो गए?
o: July 1905
December 1903
August 1905
October 1905
e: Detailed Explanation: Despite extensive petitions, the government formally announced the partition plan in July 1905. This sparked immediate widespread outrage, and localized protest meetings in small towns across Bengal first took the pledge to boycott foreign goods.

qe: The formal proclamation of the historic Swadeshi Movement was made on August 7, 1905, following the passage of the Boycott Resolution at which landmark meeting?
qh: बायकाट प्रस्ताव (Boycott Resolution) पारित होने के बाद 7 अगस्त, 1905 को किस ऐतिहासिक बैठक में ऐतिहासिक स्वदेशी आंदोलन की औपचारिक घोषणा की गई थी?
o: A massive meeting held in the Calcutta Townhall
The annual national session convened at Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College
A regional protest assembly organized at the public Chawdar tank
An open-air volunteer convention hosted inside Fergusson College, Pune
e: Detailed Explanation: On August 7, 1905, a massive public meeting was held at the Calcutta Townhall. The historic Boycott Resolution was passed here, marking the formal proclamation and launch of the Swadeshi Movement.

qe: Following the townhall proclamation of the Swadeshi Movement, nationalist leaders quickly dispersed across the province to propagate the message of boycotting which specific British import goods?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन की टाउनहॉल घोषणा के बाद, राष्ट्रवादी नेता किस विशिष्ट ब्रिटिश आयातित वस्तुओं के बहिष्कार के संदेश को प्रसारित करने के लिए पूरे प्रांत में तेजी से फैल गए?
o: Manchester cloth and Liverpool salt
Foreign non-ionic liquid detergents and dyes
Superconducting machinery tools and steel tracks
Opium shipments and sugarcane agricultural inputs
e: Detailed Explanation: The core economic tactic of the early Swadeshi movement was hitting British commercial interests directly. Leaders traveled to different districts to preach the total boycott of Manchester-manufactured cloth and Liverpool-produced salt.

qe: On October 16, 1905, the partition of Bengal formally came into force. How was this specific landmark day observed by the public across Bengal to register their resistance?
qh: 16 अक्टूबर, 1905 को बंगाल का विभाजन औपचारिक रूप से लागू हुआ। जनता ने अपना विरोध दर्ज कराने के लिए बंगाल भर में इस विशिष्ट ऐतिहासिक दिन को किस रूप में मनाया?
o: As a day of mourning where people fasted, bathed in the Ganga, and walked barefoot in processions
By launching an immediate armed parameters conflict against the local police
Through the complete permanent migration of the working class toward Bihar plains
By convening an extra-ordinary secret session of the Federal judicial court
e: Detailed Explanation: October 16, 1905, was observed as a collective day of mourning. The public fasted, wore black bands, bathed in the Ganga, and marched barefoot in massive silent processions as a symbol of grief and resistance.

qe: Which celebrated patriotic song, composed by Rabindranath Tagore during the anti-partition processions, later became the national anthem of present-day Bangladesh?
qh: विभाजन-विरोधी जुलूसों के दौरान रवींद्रनाथ टैगोर द्वारा रचित कौन सा प्रसिद्ध देशभक्ति गीत बाद में वर्तमान बांग्लादेश का राष्ट्रीय गान बना?
o: Amar Sonar Bangla
Bande Mataram
Jana Gana Mana
Sare Jahan Se Achha
e: Detailed Explanation: Rabindranath Tagore composed 'Amar Sonar Bangla' during the height of the anti-partition movement. It was sung by marching crowds in the streets of Calcutta and was later adopted as the national anthem of Bangladesh.

qe: What unique fraternal ritual did the people of Bengal perform on October 16, 1905, to symbolize the underlying, unbreakable unity of the two partitioned halves of the province?
qh: बंगाल के लोगों ने 16 अक्टूबर, 1905 को प्रांत के दोनों विभाजित हिस्सों की अंतर्निहित, अटूट एकता का प्रतीक बनाने के लिए कौन सा अनूठा भाईचारे का अनुष्ठान किया था?
o: They tied rakhis on each other's hands
They mixed soil solutions from eastern and western districts into a single vase
They completely burned copies of the newly amended Registration Act publicly
They distributed non-caloric artificial sweeteners inside local temples
e: Detailed Explanation: At the suggestion of Rabindranath Tagore, the day of partition was celebrated as Rakhi Bandhan day. People tied rakhis on each other's wrists as a symbolic declaration that the artificial administrative borders drawn by the British could not splinter the emotional unity of Bengalis.

qe: Later in the day on October 16, 1905, Surendranath Banerjea and Ananda Mohan Bose addressed a massive nationalist gathering. How much capital was spontaneously raised for the movement within a few hours of this meeting?
qh: 16 अक्टूबर, 1905 को बाद में सुरेन्द्रनाथ बनर्जी और आनंद मोहन बोस ने एक विशाल राष्ट्रवादी सभा को संबोधित किया। इस बैठक के कुछ ही घंटों के भीतर आंदोलन के लिए स्वतः ही कितनी पूंजी जुटाई गई थी?
e: Detailed Explanation: The public meeting addressed by Banerjea and Bose on the afternoon of October 16 drew immense crowds. Reflecting the intense public support, a sum of Rs 50,000 was spontaneously collected within a few hours to fund the Swadeshi struggle.

qe: The Swadeshi Movement quickly expanded beyond the borders of Bengal. Which nationalist leaders successfully spearheaded the movement in Poona and Bombay?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन तेजी से बंगाल की सीमाओं से बाहर फैल गया। किन राष्ट्रवादी नेताओं ने पूना और बॉम्बे में इस आंदोलन का सफलतापूर्वक नेतृत्व किया था?
o: Bal Gangadhar Tilak
Lala Lajpat Rai and Ajit Singh
Syed Haider Raza
Chidambaram Pillai
e: Detailed Explanation: Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak recognized the national potential of the anti-partition cause and successfully introduced and led the Swadeshi and boycott campaign across Poona and the Bombay Presidency.

qe: The message of Swadeshi and boycott of foreign goods was actively carried to the North-Western regions of India. Who organized the movement in Punjab?
qh: स्वदेशी और विदेशी वस्तुओं के बहिष्कार का संदेश सक्रिय रूप से भारत के उत्तर-पश्चिमी क्षेत्रों में ले जाया गया था। पंजाब में इस आंदोलन का आयोजन किसने किया था?
o: Lala Lajpat Rai and Ajit Singh
Syed Haider Raza
Chidambaram Pillai
Gopal Krishna Gokhale
e: Detailed Explanation: In Punjab, the anti-partition and Swadeshi message was powerfully propagated through public mobilization led by Lala Lajpat Rai and Sardar Ajit Singh (the uncle of Bhagat Singh).

qe: Which distinct nationalist leader was responsible for organizing the administrative core of the Swadeshi Movement within Delhi?
qh: दिल्ली के भीतर स्वदेशी आंदोलन के प्रशासनिक कोर को संगठित करने के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट राष्ट्रवादी नेता जिम्मेदार था?
o: Syed Haider Raza
Chidambaram Pillai
Ananda Mohan Bose
K.K. Mitra
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swadeshi movement expanded into a pan-Indian phenomenon. In Delhi, the public agitations and boycott campaigns were led and structured by Syed Haider Raza.

qe: The Southern maritime regions of India also witnessed powerful Swadeshi agitations. Who spearheaded the movement within the Madras Presidency?
qh: भारत के दक्षिणी समुद्री क्षेत्रों में भी शक्तिशाली स्वदेशी आंदोलन देखे गए। मद्रास प्रेसीडेंसी के भीतर इस आंदोलन का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
o: Chidambaram Pillai
Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Surendranath Banerjea
Aurobindo Ghosh
e: Detailed Explanation: In the Madras Presidency, the Swadeshi campaign and nationalist public speeches were powerfully organized under the leadership of Chidambaram Pillai (who famously launched the Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company).

qe: The Indian National Congress met in 1905 under the presidentship of Gopal Krishna Gokhale. What specific formal resolutions were passed during this annual session?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की बैठक 1905 में गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले की अध्यक्षता में हुई थी। इस वार्षिक सत्र के दौरान कौन से विशिष्ट औपचारिक प्रस्ताव पारित किए गए थे?
o: To condemn the partition of Bengal and the reactionary policies of Curzon, and to support the Swadeshi Movement of Bengal
To declare absolute immediate independence and initiate armed guerrilla conflicts across provinces
To completely merge the Congress infrastructure with the orthodox Dharma Sabha coalition
To mandate the exclusive use of English language instead of vernaculars inside all district boards
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1905 Banaras session of the Congress, presided over by the Moderate leader G.K. Gokhale, formally resolved to condemn Curzon's reactionary administration and the partition of Bengal, while extending official support to the ongoing Swadeshi movement within Bengal.

qe: During the 1905 Congress session, a tactical divide emerged regarding the scope of the movement. What expansion did militant nationalists like Tilak, Lajpat Rai, and Bipin Chandra Pal advocate?
qh: 1905 के कांग्रेस सत्र के दौरान, आंदोलन के दायरे को लेकर एक रणनीतिक विभाजन सामने आया। तिलक, लाजपत राय और विपिन चंद्र पाल जैसे उग्रवादी राष्ट्रवादियों ने किस विस्तार की वकालत की थी?
o: To take the movement outside Bengal to other parts of the country and transform it into a full-fledged political mass struggle for Swaraj
To restrict all active boycott agitations strictly to the municipal limits of Calcutta townhall
To request the British Crown to completely dissolve the provincial legislative councils permanently
To completely halt any ongoing vernacular publication propaganda channels
e: Detailed Explanation: The Extremists (militant nationalists) wanted to expand the movement beyond Bengal to make it a truly pan-Indian mass struggle. They advocated moving past a simple economic boycott of goods to launch a full-fledged political mass resistance with the ultimate goal of attaining Swaraj.

qe: A historic constitutional declaration was made at the Calcutta Congress session of 1906 under the presidentship of Dadabhai Naoroji. What was officially declared as the central goal of the Indian National Congress?
qh: दादाभाई नौरोजी की अध्यक्षता में 1906 के कलकत्ता कांग्रेस सत्र में एक ऐतिहासिक संवैधानिक घोषणा की गई थी। भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के मुख्य लक्ष्य के रूप में आधिकारिक तौर पर क्या घोषित किया गया था?
o: Self-government or Swaraj like the United Kingdom or its colonies of Australia and Canada
The direct administrative replacement of the Viceroy by a British Cabinet Secretary of State exclusively
A complete integration of local agrarian fields with international financial market prices
The mandatory implementation of non-competitive allosteric inhibitors inside all local schools
e: Detailed Explanation: At the Calcutta session of 1906, Dadabhai Naoroji used his presidential platform to declare that the ultimate goal of the Congress was 'self-government or Swaraj', explicitly modeled on the autonomous status enjoyed by self-governing British colonies like Canada and Australia.

qe: The ideological deadlock between the Moderates and Extremists regarding the pace and techniques of struggle culminated in a historic party split. At which session did this split occur?
qh: संघर्ष की गति और तकनीकों के संबंध में नरमपंथियों और गरमपंथियों के बीच वैचारिक गतिरोध के परिणामस्वरूप एक ऐतिहासिक पार्टी विभाजन हुआ। यह विभाजन किस सत्र में हुआ था?
o: The Surat session of 1907
The Calcutta session of 1906
The Banaras session of 1905
The Lucknow session of 1916
e: Detailed Explanation: The growing rift over leadership and methodologies reached an absolute deadlock at the Surat session of 1907. The resulting 'Surat Split' severely weakened the organizational unity of the national movement and had serious negative consequences for the Swadeshi Movement.

qe: After 1905, why did the Extremist leadership acquire a dominant influence over the Swadeshi Movement within Bengal, shifting it away from the Moderate path?
qh: 1905 के बाद, बंगाल के भीतर स्वदेशी आंदोलन पर गरमदलीय (Extremist) नेतृत्व ने एक प्रमुख प्रभाव क्यों प्राप्त किया, जिससे यह नरमपंथी मार्ग से दूर हो गया?
o: The Moderate-led petitions failed to yield concrete results, and the government resorted to severe suppressive measures
The Moderates voluntarily resigned from their positions to join the orthodox Dharma Sabha
The British administration provided massive financial subsidies exclusively to Extremist journals
The local village moneylenders completely liquidated all peasant debts inside the western half
e: Detailed Explanation: The Extremists gained dominance because the traditional Moderate methods of petitions and memoranda failed to stop the implementation of the partition. Furthermore, the divisive tactics of the state and its brutal suppression of student protestors embittered the public, turning them toward radical options.

qe: To crush the Swadeshi Movement, the colonial government deployed highly suppressive measures against the student population. Which of the following highlights a measure they used?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन को कुचलने के लिए औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने छात्र आबादी के खिलाफ अत्यधिक दमनकारी उपाय अपनाए। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा उनके द्वारा उपयोग किए जाने वाले उपाय को रेखांकित करता है?
o: Inflicting corporal punishment on students and restricting their enrollment privileges
Providing free advanced technical education grants exclusively to non-official Indian student groups
Forcing all student volunteers to compile bilingual dictionaries in classical Sanskrit loops
Mandating that every student must ingest non-caloric artificial sweetening agents daily
e: Detailed Explanation: The state targeted students because they were the backbone of picket lines and processions. Suppressive measures included inflicting brutal corporal punishment on young students, rusticating them from schools, and threatening institutions with the withdrawal of grants.

qe: As part of its suppressive campaign against nationalist expressions, what cultural restriction did the colonial government legally enforce in public spaces?
qh: राष्ट्रवादी अभिव्यक्तियों के खिलाफ अपने दमनकारी अभियान के हिस्से के रूप में, औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने सार्वजनिक स्थानों पर कौन सा सांस्कृतिक प्रतिबंध कानूनी रूप से लागू किया था?
o: A total ban on the public singing of Vande Mataram
The absolute prohibition of using local vernacular languages in commerce trade
A mandatory registration rule forcing people to carry standard red books everywhere
A ban on the manufacturing of traditional soft potassium cosmetic soaps
e: Detailed Explanation: To suppress the emotional tide of the movement, the government passed circulars that placed a complete ban on the public singing of the patriotic song 'Vande Mataram', treating it as an act of sedition.

qe: The comprehensive 'Passive Resistance' program outlined by the Extremist leadership went far beyond a simple boycott of British cloth. What did this expanded strategy explicitly include?
qh: गरमदलीय नेतृत्व द्वारा रेखांकित व्यापक 'निष्क्रिय प्रतिरोध' (Passive Resistance) कार्यक्रम ब्रिटिश कपड़ों के एक साधारण बहिष्कार से बहुत आगे निकल गया। इस विस्तारित रणनीति में स्पष्ट रूप से क्या शामिल था?
o: A boycott of government schools, colleges, government service, courts, legislative councils, and titles
The systematic destruction of all primary agricultural fields across the eastern half
Filing joint civil lawsuits inside the Federal Court benches against the Secretary of State
An absolute requirement to replace all local municipal boards with secret religious sabhas
e: Detailed Explanation: The Extremist program focused on non-cooperation and passive resistance. They called upon citizens to boycott government-run educational institutions, colonial administrative services, British law courts, legislative councils, municipalities, and government-awarded titles.

qe: Who among the Extremist ideologues brilliantly defined the purpose of passive resistance as an organized refusal to help British officialdom, stating that 'Political freedom is the lifebreath of a nation'?
qh: गरमदलीय विचारकों में से किसने निष्क्रिय प्रतिरोध के उद्देश्य को ब्रिटिश अधिकारियों की मदद करने से एक संगठित इनकार के रूप में परिभाषित किया था, और कहा था कि 'राजनीतिक स्वतंत्रता एक राष्ट्र की जीवन सांस है'?
o: Aurobindo Ghosh
Bal Gangadhar Tilak
Surendranath Banerjea
Dadabhai Naoroji
e: Detailed Explanation: Aurobindo Ghosh was the key philosophical architect of the passive resistance program. He wrote extensively that the goal was to make British administration impossible through an organized refusal to cooperate, famously declaring that political freedom is essential to a nation's life.

qe: A logistics routing path loops through a right-angled triangle mapping. A transport car travels 60 km North from junction O, and then drives 11 km East to reach storage point S. Find the straight-line distance from O to S.
qh: एक परिवहन कार जंक्शन O से 60 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलती है, और फिर पूर्व की ओर 11 किमी जाकर भंडारण बिंदु S पर पहुँचती है। O से S की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 61 km
71 km
65 km
63 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This spatial path sets up a classic right-angled triangle configuration with legs measuring 60 km and 11 km. The straight-line distance is the hypotenuse.
Applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{60^2 + 11^2} = \sqrt{3600 + 121} = \sqrt{3721} = \mathbf{61\text{ km}}$.

qe: In a biological ecosystem study tracking energy metrics, if the Net Primary Productivity (NPP) of a forest tract is measured at 24,000 units and the energy lost during plant respiration (R) is 16,000 units, calculate the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP).
qh: ऊर्जा मानकों पर नज़र रखने वाले एक जैविक पारितंत्र अध्ययन में, यदि एक वन क्षेत्र की शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) 24,000 इकाइयाँ मापी जाती है और पौधों के श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा 16,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) की गणना करें।
o: 40,000 units
8,000 units
32,000 units
48,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the baseline ecological energy flow equation: $NPP = GPP - R$, we rewrite it to isolate Gross Primary Productivity: $GPP = NPP + R$.
Substituting the values: $GPP = 24,000 + 16,000 = \mathbf{40,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: The viceroy who masterminded the partition of Bengal attempted to win over Muslim communalists by offering a specific political vision for Dacca. Who was this viceroy?
qh: बंगाल के विभाजन की योजना बनाने वाले वायसराय ने ढाका के लिए एक विशिष्ट राजनीतिक दृष्टिकोण की पेशकश करके मुस्लिम सांप्रदायिकों को अपने पक्ष में करने का प्रयास किया था। यह वायसराय कौन था?
o: Lord Curzon
Lord Wellesley
Lord William Bentinck
Lord Ripon
e: Detailed Explanation: Lord Curzon was the Viceroy of India who engineered the partition plan. He toured eastern Bengal and explicitly gave speeches to woo Muslims, arguing that making Dacca the capital of a new Muslim-majority province would restore a sense of unity they had not experienced since the days of old Muslim kings.

qe: The theme song that almost spontaneously became the standard anthem of the entire anti-partition and Swadeshi Movement, sung by crowds during barefoot processions, was:
qh: वह विषय गीत जो लगभग स्वतः ही पूरे विभाजन-विरोधी और स्वदेशी आंदोलन का मानक गान बन गया, और जिसे नंगे पैर जुलूसों के दौरान भीड़ द्वारा गाया जाता था, वह था:
o: Bande Mataram
Amar Sonar Bangla
Jana Gana Mana
Sare Jahan Se Achha
e: Detailed Explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee's 'Bande Mataram' became the definitive theme song of the Swadeshi Movement. It was sung by thousands of people as they marched through the streets in barefoot protest processions across Bengal.

qe: The Indian National Congress session hosted at Calcutta in 1906 is highly significant because its declaration directly influenced the Extremist program. Who presided over this historic session?
qh: 1906 में कलकत्ता में आयोजित भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का सत्र अत्यधिक महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि इसकी घोषणा ने सीधे गरमदलीय कार्यक्रम को प्रभावित किया था। इस ऐतिहासिक सत्र की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी?
o: Dadabhai Naoroji
Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Bal Gangadhar Tilak
Surendranath Banerjea
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1906 Calcutta session of the Congress was presided over by the venerable leader Dadabhai Naoroji. His presidential declaration designating self-government or Swaraj as the ultimate goal of the Congress gave structural validation to the radical programs of the Extremists.

qe: What was the primary long-term strategic objective shared by both the Moderate and Extremist factions within the Swadeshi Movement, despite their deep disputes over pace and techniques?
qh: गति और तकनीकों पर उनके गहरे विवादों के बावजूद, स्वदेशी आंदोलन के भीतर नरमपंथी और गरमपंथी दोनों गुटों द्वारा साझा किया गया प्राथमिक दीर्घकालिक रणनीतिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: The ultimate reversal of the partition of Bengal and the structural advancement of the nation
The complete conversion of all local schools into English-only military academies
Forcing the central government to permanently freeze the functions of the Supreme Court
The systematic preservation of the socio-economic inequalities managed by local zamindars
e: Detailed Explanation: Despite their programmatic deadlock at Surat over the pace of the agitation, both the Moderates and Extremists shared the core goals of reversing the partition of Bengal and achieving self-governing advancement for the country.

qe: Under the passive resistance strategy, the slogan of absolute independence from foreign rule was given a central place in national politics. According to the Extremist ideology, this goal was to be achieved through:
qh: निष्क्रिय प्रतिरोध रणनीति के तहत, विदेशी शासन से पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता के नारे को राष्ट्रीय राजनीति में एक केंद्रीय स्थान दिया गया था। गरमदलीय विचारधारा के अनुसार, इस लक्ष्य को किसके माध्यम से प्राप्त किया जाना था?
o: Self-sacrifice and organized mass non-cooperation
Filing formal legal petitions regularly before the British Parliament
Securing administrative concession titles from the Viceroy's executive council
The physical structural relocation of all national headquarters to London directly
e: Detailed Explanation: The militant nationalists (Extremists) believed that political freedom could not be achieved through minor administrative concessions or prayers. They introduced the concept of mass non-cooperation and emphasized that the ultimate goal of absolute independence must be won through mass self-sacrifice and relentless passive resistance.

qe: During the Swadeshi and Boycott Movement, the boycott of foreign goods was implemented through unique socio-religious methods at the popular level. Which of the following is an example of such a method?
qh: स्वदेशी और बहिष्कार आंदोलन के दौरान, लोकप्रिय स्तर पर अनूठे सामाजिक-धार्मिक तरीकों के माध्यम से विदेशी वस्तुओं का बहिष्कार लागू किया गया था। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा ऐसे तरीके का एक उदाहरण है?
o: Refusal by priests to ritualize marriages involving the exchange of foreign goods
Total migration of upper-caste priesthood networks away from the towns
Compulsory introduction of English as the medium for marriage rituals
A complete legal ban on the exchange of raw traditional agricultural produce
e: Detailed Explanation: The boycott went beyond burning foreign cloth; it included everyday resistance where priests refused to perform marriage rituals that exchanged foreign goods, and washermen refused to wash imported clothes, making it highly effective at the popular level.

qe: The 'Swadesh Bandhab Samiti', which emerged as a highly popular and powerful organizational means of mass mobilization in Barisal, was founded by which reformer?
qh: बारीसाल में जन लामबंदी के एक अत्यधिक लोकप्रिय और शक्तिशाली संगठनात्मक साधन के रूप में उभरने वाली 'स्वदेश बांधव समिति' की स्थापना किस सुधारक द्वारा की गई थी?
o: Ashwini Kumar Dutta
Surendranath Banerjea
Ananda Mohan Bose
Sisir Kumar Ghosh
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swadesh Bandhab Samiti was established by Ashwini Kumar Dutta in Barisal (Bengal). This samiti generated political consciousness through magic lantern lectures, swadeshi songs, and humanitarian work during famines.

qe: In Tirunelveli (Tamil Nadu), which nationalist setup was formed by V.O. Chidambaram Pillai and Subramania Siva along with local lawyers to generate political consciousness?
qh: तिरुनेलवेली (तमिलनाडु) में, राजनीतिक चेतना पैदा करने के लिए स्थानीय वकीलों के साथ वी.ओ. चिदंबरम पिल्लई और सुब्रमण्य शिव द्वारा किस राष्ट्रवादी संगठन का गठन किया गया था?
o: Swadeshi Sangam
Swadesh Bandhab Samiti
Social Service League
Servants of India Society
e: Detailed Explanation: V.O. Chidambaram Pillai and Subramania Siva, along with several local lawyers, founded the 'Swadeshi Sangam' in Tamil Nadu. It served as a powerful vehicle to inspire the masses and impart physical, moral, and political training.

qe: The concept of self-reliance or 'Atma Shakti', which became a running theme during the Swadeshi campaign, practically emphasized which social agenda?
qh: स्वदेशी अभियान के दौरान एक मुख्य विषय बनने वाली आत्म-निर्भरता या 'आत्म शक्ति' की अवधारणा ने व्यावहारिक रूप से किस सामाजिक एजेंडे पर बल दिया?
o: Social reform and campaigns against caste oppression, early marriage, and the dowry system
The complete operational adoption of Western liberal individualistic traditions
A total permanent non-cooperation with traditional folk theatre forms and melas
Encouraging the exclusive dependency of rural ryots on central banking credit lines
e: Detailed Explanation: Self-reliance or 'Atma Shakti' implied a re-assertion of national dignity and the socio-economic regeneration of villages. Practically, it was tied to social reforms, including crusades against caste discrimination, child marriage, dowry, and consumption of alcohol.

qe: The Bengal National College, founded during the height of the educational boycott movement, was structurally inspired by Tagore's Shantiniketan. Who was appointed as its very first Principal?
qh: बहिष्कार आंदोलन के दौरान स्थापित 'बंगाल नेशनल कॉलेज' टैगोर के शांतिनिकेतन से संरचनात्मक रूप से प्रेरित था। इसके सबसे पहले प्राचार्य (Principal) के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया था?
o: Aurobindo Ghosh
Rabindranath Tagore
Satish Chandra Mukherjee
Ananda Mohan Bose
e: Detailed Explanation: The Bengal National College was set up on national lines to provide an alternative to colonial education. Aurobindo Ghosh served as its pioneering first principal, while national schools soon sprang up in other parts of India.

qe: On August 15, 1906, a specialized apex body was established to organize a comprehensive system of literary, scientific, and technical education under national control. What was the name of this body?
qh: 15 अगस्त, 1906 को राष्ट्रीय नियंत्रण के तहत साहित्यिक, वैज्ञानिक और तकनीकी शिक्षा की एक व्यापक प्रणाली को व्यवस्थित करने के लिए एक विशेष निकाय की स्थापना की गई थी। इस निकाय का नाम क्या था?
o: National Council of Education
Bengal Institute of Technology
Tattvabodhini Educational Council
Indian Society of Oriental Art
e: Detailed Explanation: The National Council of Education was established on August 15, 1906, to organize a system of primary, secondary, and higher education on national lines, under national control, with the vernacular language serving as the medium of instruction.

qe: To promote industrial self-reliance and advanced technical learning, where did the National Council of Education raise funds to send Indian students for advanced training?
qh: औद्योगिक आत्मनिर्भरता और उन्नत तकनीकी शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देने के लिए, नेशनल काउंसिल ऑफ एजुकेशन ने भारतीय छात्रों को उन्नत प्रशिक्षण के लिए भेजने के लिए कहाँ धन जुटाया था?
o: Japan
Great Britain
Germany
The United States
e: Detailed Explanation: In conjunction with setting up the Bengal Institute of Technology for local technical training, the nationalist leadership raised separate funds to send promising Indian students to Japan for advanced scientific and technical learning.

qe: V.O. Chidambaram Pillai launched a highly celebrated indigenous shipping enterprise to directly challenge the commercial monopoly of the British Indian Steam Navigation Company. What was the name of his company?
qh: वी.ओ. चिदंबरम पिल्लई ने ब्रिटिश इंडियन स्टीम नेविगेशन कंपनी के व्यावसायिक एकाधिकार को सीधे चुनौती देने के लिए एक प्रसिद्ध स्वदेशी शिपिंग उद्यम शुरू किया था। उनकी कंपनी का क्या नाम था?
o: Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company
The Indian League Shipping Corporation
Tuticorin Marine Enterprise
Swadeshi Maritime Alliance
e: Detailed Explanation: V.O. Chidambaram Pillai established the Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company at Tuticorin. This enterprise directly challenged British maritime dominance, standing as a stellar example of indigenous commercial enterprise based on patriotic zeal.

qe: In the field of nationalist art and painting, which prominent artist successfully broke the domination of Victorian naturalism over the Indian art scene by drawing inspiration from Ajanta, Mughal, and Rajput paintings?
qh: राष्ट्रवादी कला और चित्रकला के क्षेत्र में, किस प्रमुख कलाकार ने अजंता, मुगल और राजपूत चित्रों से प्रेरणा लेकर भारतीय कला परिदृश्य पर विक्टोरियन प्रकृतिवाद (Victorian naturalism) के वर्चस्व को सफलतापूर्वक तोड़ा?
o: Abanindranath Tagore
Nandalal Bose
Rabindranath Tagore
Gaganendranath Tagore
e: Detailed Explanation: Abanindranath Tagore revolutionized Indian art by breaking away from Western Victorian naturalism. He established a distinctive indigenous style inspired by the rich classical aesthetic heritage of Ajanta, Mughal, and Rajput miniatures.

qe: Who holds the distinction of being the very first recipient of the specialized art scholarship offered by the Indian Society of Oriental Art, which was founded in 1907?
qh: 1907 में स्थापित 'इंडियन सोसाइटी ऑफ ओरिएंटल आर्ट' (Indian Society of Oriental Art) द्वारा दी जाने वाली विशेष कला छात्रवृत्ति के सबसे पहले प्राप्तकर्ता होने का गौरव किसे प्राप्त है?
o: Nandalal Bose
Abanindranath Tagore
Asit Kumar Haldar
Kshitindranath Majumdar
e: Detailed Explanation: Nandalal Bose, a student of Abanindranath Tagore who left a major structural imprint on modern Indian art, was honored as the first recipient of the scholarship offered by the Indian Society of Oriental Art in 1907.

qe: To crush student participation in the Swadeshi agitations, the colonial administration implemented severe disciplinary and fiscal penalties. Which of the following highlights a restriction students faced?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलनों में छात्रों की भागीदारी को कुचलने के लिए, औपनिवेशिक प्रशासन ने गंभीर अनुशासनात्मक और वित्तीय दंड लागू किए। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा प्रतिबंध छात्रों को झेलना पड़ा?
o: Disqualification for government jobs and scholarships, along with disaffiliation or stoppage of grants to their institutions
Compulsory legal conscription into the active British maritime shipping lines
Forcing them to pay a direct financial tax to the Bengal Institute of Technology
A complete legal ban on using the vernacular language inside their households
e: Detailed Explanation: The government passed strict circulars stating that schools and colleges whose students participated in picketing would lose their affiliation and government grants, while participating students were disqualified from scholarships and government jobs.

qe: While several sections of the Muslim community participated in the Swadeshi Movement, a large section of the upper and middle-class Muslim elite stayed away under the leadership of which prominent figure?
qh: जबकि मुस्लिम समुदाय के कई वर्गों ने स्वदेशी आंदोलन में भाग लिया, उच्च और मध्यम वर्ग के मुस्लिम अभिजात वर्ग का एक बड़ा हिस्सा किस प्रमुख व्यक्ति के नेतृत्व में इससे दूर रहा?
o: Nawab Salimullah of Dacca
Liaqat Hussain
Abdul Rasul
Maulana Azad
e: Detailed Explanation: A large section of the upper and middle-class Muslim elite, led by Nawab Salimullah of Dacca, supported the partition of Bengal on the plea that it would grant them a separate Muslim-majority province in East Bengal where their interests would dominate.

qe: In September 1905, a major labor strike erupted when more than 250 Bengali clerks staged a walkout to protest against a derogatory work regulation. In which company did this strike take place?
qh: सितंबर 1905 में, एक बड़ा श्रम आंदोलन तब भड़का जब 250 से अधिक बंगाली क्लर्कों ने एक अपमानजनक कार्य नियम के विरोध में वॉकआउट किया। यह हड़ताल किस कंपनी में हुई थी?
o: The Burn Company, Howrah
The East Indian Railway
The Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company
The British Indian Steam Navigation Company
e: Detailed Explanation: In September 1905, more than 250 Bengali clerks employed at the foreign-owned Burn Company in Howrah walked out in a well-organized protest against a derogatory work regulation, marking an early entry of white-collar labor into the movement.

qe: A widespread strike among the workers of the East Indian Railway in July 1906 directly culminated in the institutional formation of which body?
qh: जुलाई 1906 में ईस्ट इंडियन रेलवे के श्रमिकों के बीच एक व्यापक हड़ताल के परिणामस्वरूप सीधे तौर पर किस निकाय का संस्थागत गठन हुआ था?
o: The Railwaymen’s Union
The All India Trade Union Congress
The Swadeshi Sangam Council
The Social Service League
e: Detailed Explanation: The political expression of labor grievances expanded during 1906. A major strike by the workers of the East Indian Railway in July 1906 led directly to the structural formation of the historic Railwaymen’s Union.

qe: Between 1906 and 1908, labor unrest reached an extraordinary peak in Bengal’s manufacturing sector, with strikes frequently affecting up to 18 out of 18 mills simultaneously. Which specific industry was affected?
qh: 1806 और 1908 के बीच, बंगाल के विनिर्माण क्षेत्र में श्रम अशांति एक असाधारण चरम पर पहुँच गई, जहाँ हड़तालों ने अक्सर एक साथ 18 में से 18 मिलों को प्रभावित किया। कौन सा विशिष्ट उद्योग इससे प्रभावित हुआ था?
o: The jute mills
The cotton textile mills
The match and soap factories
The heavy steel foundries
e: Detailed Explanation: The working class actively linked their economic hardships with the nationalist cause. Between 1906 and 1908, intense industrial strikes were frequent in the jute mills of Bengal, completely paralyzing production across all 18 operating mills at times.

qe: In Rawalpindi (Punjab), the arsenal and railway workshop workers went on a major strike in solidarity with the nationalist movement. Who provided the leadership for this industrial strike?
qh: रावलपिंडी (पंजाब) में, शस्त्रागार (arsenal) और रेलवे कार्यशाला के कर्मचारी राष्ट्रवादी आंदोलन के समर्थन में एक बड़ी हड़ताल पर चले गए। इस औद्योगिक हड़ताल को नेतृत्व किसने प्रदान किया था?
o: Lala Lajpat Rai and Ajit Singh
Bal Gangadhar Tilak and G.V. Joshi
Syed Haider Raza and Subramania Siva
V.O. Chidambaram Pillai and Kumaran Asan
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swadeshi unrest expanded into Punjab, where labor grievances were actively politicized. In Rawalpindi, the strategic arsenal and railway workers executed a major strike under the leadership of Lala Lajpat Rai and Sardar Ajit Singh.

qe: By which year did the open, mass phase of the Swadeshi and Boycott movement almost entirely fizzle out and decline into inactivity before transitioning into an underground revolutionary phase?
qh: किस वर्ष तक स्वदेशी और बहिष्कार आंदोलन का खुला, जन चरण लगभग पूरी तरह से समाप्त हो गया और भूमिगत क्रांतिकारी चरण में बदलने से पहले निष्क्रियता में बदल गया?
e: Detailed Explanation: By the year 1908, the open phase of the Swadeshi and Boycott movement was almost completely over, due to intense government suppression, internal splits, and the arrest or retirement of its frontline leaders.

qe: A major internal factor that harmed the operational focus of the Swadeshi Movement was its failure to give a disciplined focus to its techniques. Which political split magnified these internal squabbles in 1907?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन के परिचालन फोकस को नुकसान पहुँचाने वाला एक प्रमुख आंतरिक कारक अपनी तकनीकों को अनुशासित फोकस देने में इसकी विफलता थी। 1907 में किस राजनीतिक विभाजन ने इन आंतरिक झगड़ों को बढ़ा दिया था?
o: The Surat Split
The Gaya Schism
The Lucknow Deadlock
The Allahabad Separation
e: Detailed Explanation: The ideological and tactical conflict between the Moderates and Extremists culminated in the historic Surat Split of 1907. These internal squabbles split the party, causing deep organizational damage and accelerating the decline of the mass movement.

qe: By 1908, the open Swadeshi movement was rendered largely leaderless. While several leaders were arrested or deported, which two prominent ideolologues completely retired from active politics at this juncture?
qh: 1908 तक, खुला स्वदेशी आंदोलन काफी हद तक नेताविहीन हो गया था। जबकि कई नेताओं को गिरफ्तार या निर्वासित किया गया था, कौन से दो प्रमुख विचारक इस मोड़ पर सक्रिय राजनीति से पूरी तरह से सेवानिवृत्त हो गए?
o: Aurobindo Ghosh and Bipin Chandra Pal
Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Lala Lajpat Rai
Surendranath Banerjea and Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Ashwini Kumar Dutta and Chidambaram Pillai
e: Detailed Explanation: Beyond the prison sentences given to Tilak, the movement lost its core ideological guidance because Aurobindo Ghosh shifted toward spiritualism and Bipin Chandra Pal completely retired from active politics by 1908.

qe: Despite its eventual decline, the Swadeshi Movement stood as a historic turning point and a 'leap forward' because it successfully brought which hitherto untouched sections into active political work?
qh: अपने अंतिम पतन के बावजूद, स्वदेशी आंदोलन एक ऐतिहासिक मोड़ और एक 'आगे की लंबी छलांग' के रूप में खड़ा रहा क्योंकि इसने सक्रिय राजनीतिक कार्य में सफलतापूर्वक किन अछूते वर्गों को शामिल किया?
o: Students, women, and urban/rural working-class workers
Exclusively the wealthy, loyalist princely rulers
Only the English-medium westernized barristers of Calcutta
The aristocratic zamindars of the Permanent Settlement areas exclusively
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swadeshi Movement significantly expanded the social base of Indian nationalism. It was a leap forward because it actively mobilized sections of society that had previously remained untouched by politics, most notably students, women, and industrial workers.

qe: The Swadeshi Movement stood as a rich historical laboratory where all the major ideological trends of the future national struggle emerged. Which set of techniques was thrown up during this campaign?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन एक समृद्ध ऐतिहासिक प्रयोगशाला के रूप में खड़ा रहा जहाँ भविष्य के राष्ट्रीय संघर्ष के सभी प्रमुख वैचारिक रुझान उभरे। इस अभियान के दौरान तकनीकों का कौन सा समूह सामने आया था?
o: Non-cooperation, passive resistance, filling of British jails, social reform, and constructive village work
Exclusive reliance on secret legal appeals before the Privy Council in London
The direct physical destruction of all vernacular printing machinery assets
Complete compliance with the 'providential mission theory' of the British Crown
e: Detailed Explanation: The Swadeshi campaign served as the foundational testing ground for modern Indian politics. It threw up an entire spectrum of resistance techniques—including non-cooperation, passive resistance, jail-filling, social reform, and constructive village work—which were later masterfully disciplined and implemented during the Gandhian era.

qe: How did the ideological inspiration of the Moderate leaders differ fundamentally from that of the newly emerged Extremist leaders in the early 20th century?
qh: 20वीं शताब्दी की शुरुआत में नरमपंथी (Moderate) नेताओं की वैचारिक प्रेरणा नव-उभरे गरमपंथी (Extremist) नेताओं से मौलिक रूप से किस प्रकार भिन्न थी?
o: Moderates drew inspiration from Western liberal thought and European history, while Extremists drew from Indian history, cultural heritage, and traditional symbols
Moderates relied strictly on the physical thermodynamic theories of ancient scriptures
Extremists drew their entire ideological validation from British parliamentary charters exclusively
There was no difference; both groups subscribed fully to the 'providential mission theory' of England
e: Detailed Explanation: The groups had distinct intellectual roots. The Moderates were deeply influenced by Western liberal philosophy and European constitutional history, whereas the Extremists looked inward, drawing their ideological strength and pride from Indian history, ancient cultural heritage, and traditional popular symbols.

qe: The Moderates firmly believed in 'England's providential mission in India'. How did the Extremist leadership structurally respond to this theory?
qh: नरमपंथी 'भारत में इंग्लैंड के दैवीय मिशन' (England's providential mission in India) में दृढ़ विश्वास रखते थे। गरमदलीय नेतृत्व ने इस सिद्धांत पर संरचनात्मक रूप से क्या प्रतिक्रिया दी?
o: They completely rejected the 'providential mission theory' as a dangerous colonial illusion
They integrated it fully into the D.A.V. College curriculum as a core guiding principle
They petitioned the British Parliament to make the theory a mandatory legal civil code
They used it as a basis to demand separate electorates for lower-caste village panchayats
e: Detailed Explanation: The Extremists completely discarded the Moderate idea of a benevolent British mission. They rejected the 'providential mission theory' as an illusion, arguing instead that political connection with Britain was inherently exploitative and designed to drain India's resources.

qe: When formulating their absolute political goals, how did the internal perceptions of the ultimate destination vary between Lokmanya Tilak and Aurobindo Ghosh?
qh: अपने पूर्ण राजनीतिक लक्ष्यों को तैयार करते समय, लोकमान्य तिलक और अरविंद घोष के बीच अंतिम गंतव्य की आंतरिक धारणाएं कैसे भिन्न थीं?
o: For Tilak, Swaraj meant a form of self-government, while for Aurobindo it meant complete independence from foreign rule
For Tilak, the goal was the complete legal conversion of all schools into spiritual gurukuls, while Aurobindo rejected it
For Tilak, the ultimate aim was the retention of British managing agencies, while Aurobindo sought their removal
Both held identical views that the British Crown was fully worthy of claiming absolute Indian loyalty over time
e: Detailed Explanation: Even within the Extremist high command, perceptions varied. For Bal Gangadhar Tilak, Swaraj was conceptually defined as a robust form of autonomous self-government within the empire frame, whereas for Aurobindo Ghosh, it explicitly meant absolute, complete independence from any foreign rule.

qe: Despite their progressive political stance on mass participation, critics note that several Extremist leaders acted as 'social reactionaries'. Which of the following instances is cited to support this critique?
qh: जनभागीदारी पर अपने प्रगतिशील राजनीतिक रुख के बावजूद, आलोचक ध्यान देते हैं कि कई गरमदलीय नेताओं ने 'सामाजिक प्रतिक्रियावादियों' (social reactionaries) के रूप में कार्य किया। इस आलोचना के समर्थन में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा उदाहरण उद्धृत किया गया है?
o: Tilak's opposition to the Age of Consent Bill, along with support for anti-cow killing campaigns and organizing localized religious festivals
The complete administrative ban imposed by the Extremists on the study of modern physical sciences
Their formal legal petitions demanding the immediate extension of Lord Macaulay's education policy
The direct corporate recruitment of wealthy urban zamindars into the core committees of the Indian League
e: Detailed Explanation: While politically advanced in demanding mass action, many Extremists held traditional, socially conservative views. This was evident in Tilak's opposition to the Age of Consent Bill of 1891 (which raised the marriage age for girls from 10 to 12) and his deployment of religious symbols and anti-cow killing campaigns, which gave their nationalism an orthodox undertone.

qe: The strategic use of traditional religious festivals and traditional folk theatre forms by the Extremist leadership for anti-colonial propaganda had what unintended long-term impact on the social fabric of India?
qh: औपनिवेशिक विरोधी प्रचार के लिए गरमदलीय नेतृत्व द्वारा पारंपरिक धार्मिक त्योहारों और पारंपरिक लोक नाट्य रूपों के रणनीतिक उपयोग का भारत के सामाजिक ताने-बाने पर क्या अनपेक्षित दीर्घकालिक प्रभाव पड़ा?
o: It promoted an unhealthy relationship between politics and religion, inadvertently alienating many Muslims from the movement
It led to the complete financial bankruptcy of all newly opened swadeshi textile mills
It caused a total structural drop in the primary productivity metrics of local alluvial plains
It forced the National Council of Education to completely disaffiliate all its vernacular schools
e: Detailed Explanation: To mobilize the masses, Extremist leaders frequently evoked Hindu traditional symbols, goddesses, and religious festivals (like Ganapati and Shivaji festivals). Though effective against British rulers, this approach promoted an unhealthy mix of politics and religion, inadvertently alienating a large section of the Muslim community.

qe: In the year 1911, the colonial government formally decided to execute the 'Annulment of the Partition of Bengal'. What was the primary reason that forced this administrative reversal?
qh: वर्ष 1911 में, औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने औपचारिक रूप से 'बंगाल के विभाजन को रद्द करने' (Annulment of the Partition of Bengal) का निर्णय लिया। इस प्रशासनिक बदलाव को मजबूर करने का प्राथमिक कारण क्या था?
o: To curb the rising menace of revolutionary terrorism
To satisfy the financial demands of the newly formed All India Muslim League
To implement the recommendations of the Royal Commission on Decentralization
To completely merge the Bengal administrative infrastructure with the Punjab province
e: Detailed Explanation: The partition of Bengal was formally annulled by the government in 1911 during the Delhi Durbar. The primary motive behind this reversal was to contain and curb the intense menace of underground revolutionary terrorism that had emerged following the suppression of the open mass movement.

qe: To appease the Muslim political elite who were deeply shocked by the annulment of the partition of Bengal in 1911, the colonial government implemented which strategic administrative step?
qh: 1911 में बंगाल के विभाजन को रद्द करने से गहरे सदमे में आए मुस्लिम राजनीतिक अभिजात वर्ग को शांत करने के लिए, औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने कौन सा रणनीतिक प्रशासनिक कदम उठाया था?
o: Deciding to shift the imperial capital of British India to Delhi
The complete legal restoration of Persian as the sole official language of all High Courts
The immediate transfer of the entire state portfolio finance to popular ministerial control
Granting absolute exemption to Muslim peasantry from paying any land revenue shares
e: Detailed Explanation: The annulment of the partition was a blow to the Muslim elite who favored a Muslim-majority East Bengal. As a political concession and a sop to them, the British government decided to shift the imperial capital from Calcutta to Delhi, a city deeply associated with past Muslim imperial glory.

qe: When the administrative borders of the region were reorganized in 1911 along with the annulment of the partition, what territorial changes were made to the western zones?
qh: जब 1911 में विभाजन को रद्द करने के साथ ही क्षेत्र की प्रशासनिक सीमाओं को पुनर्गठित किया गया, तो पश्चिमी क्षेत्रों में क्या क्षेत्रीय परिवर्तन किए गए थे?
o: Bihar and Orissa were taken out of Bengal, and Assam was made a separate province
The entire province of Bengal was integrated directly into the Madras Presidency
Bihar was completely merged with the United Provinces administrative circle
Orissa was separated and appended directly to the Bombay Presidency layout
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1911 administrative re-mapping undid Curzon's lines but introduced new borders. Bihar and Orissa were permanently carved out of Bengal to form a separate administrative entity, while Assam was restored as a separate province.

qe: In Tamil Nadu, the Swadeshi campaign inspired extensive mass participation. Which duo of dedicated leaders powerfully organized public agitations and led strikes in foreign-owned cotton mills in Tuticorin and Tirunelveli?
qh: तमिलनाडु में स्वदेशी अभियान ने व्यापक जनभागीदारी को प्रेरित किया। समर्पित नेताओं की किस जोड़ी ने सार्वजनिक आंदोलनों को शक्तिशाली रूप से संगठित किया और तूतूकुड़ी और तिरुनेलवेली में विदेशी स्वामित्व वाली सूती मिलों में हड़तालों का नेतृत्व किया?
o: Subramania Siva and Chidambaram Pillai
Lala Lajpat Rai and Ajit Singh
Ashwini Kumar Dutta and Radhakant Deb
Henry Vivian Derozio and Balshastri Jambhekar
e: Detailed Explanation: In the South, anti-colonial agitations were led by Subramania Siva and V.O. Chidambaram Pillai. They successfully politicized the working class, organizing major industrial strikes in foreign-owned cotton mills across Tuticorin and Tirunelveli.

qe: A logistical supply route maps out a precise right-angled triangle grid from port O. A delivery vessel sails 40 km North, and then shifts orientation to move 42 km East to reach target island T. Calculate the direct straight-line distance from O to T.
qh: एक जहाज बंदरगाह O से 40 किमी उत्तर की ओर जाता है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 42 किमी चलकर लक्षित द्वीप T पर पहुँचता है। O से T की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 58 km
82 km
60 km
56 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This spatial travel tracks a right-angled triangle configuration with perpendicular legs measuring 40 km and 42 km. The straight-line distance is the hypotenuse.
By applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{40^2 + 42^2} = \sqrt{1600 + 1764} = \sqrt{3364} = \mathbf{58\text{ km}}$.

qe: In an ecological field survey monitoring a terrestrial ecosystem, if the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) of a forest biome is 55,000 units and the energy accumulated as Net Primary Productivity (NPP) is 35,000 units, calculate the energy consumed during plant respiration (R).
qh: एक स्थलीय पारितंत्र की निगरानी करने वाले एक पारिस्थितिकी क्षेत्र सर्वेक्षण में, यदि एक वन बायोम की सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 55,000 इकाइयाँ है और शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) के रूप में संचित ऊर्जा 35,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो पौधों के श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा की गणना करें।
o: 20,000 units
90,000 units
30,000 units
15,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the foundational ecological productivity balance formula: $NPP = GPP - R$, we rewrite it to isolate metabolic respiration costs: $R = GPP - NPP$.
Substituting the values: $R = 55,000 - 35,000 = \mathbf{20,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: The All India Muslim League was propped up on December 30, 1906, as an anti-Congress front during the height of the Swadeshi unrest. Where was this organization initially formed?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन के चरम के दौरान 30 दिसंबर, 1906 को भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के विरोधी मोर्चे के रूप में 'अखिल भारतीय मुस्लिम लीग' (All India Muslim League) का गठन किया गया था। इस संगठन का गठन शुरू में कहाँ हुआ था?
o: Dacca
Calcutta
Lahore
Aligarh
e: Detailed Explanation: To protect colonial interests and counter the expanding nationalist unity of the Swadeshi movement, the British administration encouraged conservative elements. This led directly to the formation of the All India Muslim League on December 30, 1906, at Dacca, under the patronage of Nawab Salimullah.

qe: During the Swadeshi Movement, traditional folk theatre forms and musical poetry were extensively deployed for mass mobilization. Which prominent Tamil poet composed the highly inspiring 'Sudesha Geetham' to arouse the public in South India?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन के दौरान, जन लामबंदी के लिए पारंपरिक लोक नाट्य रूपों और संगीत कविता का बड़े पैमाने पर उपयोग किया गया था। दक्षिण भारत में जनता को जगाने के लिए किस प्रसिद्ध तमिल कवि ने अत्यधिक प्रेरक 'सुदेश गीतम' (Sudesha Geetham) की रचना की थी?
o: Subramania Bharati
Kumaran Asan
V.O. Chidambaram Pillai
Subramania Siva
e: Detailed Explanation: Cultural expression was a vital element of mass mobilization during the movement. In the Madras Presidency, the celebrated nationalist poet Subramania Bharati composed 'Sudesha Geetham', a collection of stirring patriotic poems that aroused anti-colonial sentiment across the region.

qe: Why did the open mass phase of the Swadeshi Movement fail to garner the active baseline support of the vast majority of the Muslim peasantry in Bengal?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन का खुला जन चरण बंगाल में मुस्लिम किसानों (Muslim peasantry) के विशाल बहुमत का सक्रिय समर्थन हासिल करने में क्यों विफल रहा?
o: A conscious government policy of divide and rule, combined with an overlap of class and community lines where landlords were predominantly Hindu and peasants were Muslim
The Muslim peasantry was strictly barred from using any vernacular language channels by their religious leaders
The National Council of Education refused to allow any rural children to enroll in its schools
Peasants completely lacked any dependency on essential items like foreign-made salt or clothing cloth
e: Detailed Explanation: The movement failed to win over the rural Muslim peasantry due to a deliberate British policy of divide and rule that stoked communal configurations. Furthermore, in many parts of Bengal, class divisions overlapped with religious lines—the landlords and moneylenders were predominantly Hindu, while the poor subsistence tenants were Muslim. This structural overlap allowed conservative elites to portray the Hindu-led Swadeshi agitation as contrary to the economic interests of Muslim peasants.

qe: During the 1905 Benaras session of the Indian National Congress, the differences between the Moderates and Extremists came to the fore. What was the central point of contention regarding the Swadeshi and Boycott program?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के 1905 के बनारस अधिवेशन के दौरान, नरमपंथियों और गरमपंथियों के बीच मतभेद खुलकर सामने आए। स्वदेशी और बहिष्कार कार्यक्रम के संबंध में विवाद का मुख्य बिंदु क्या था?
o: The Extremists wanted to extend the movement outside Bengal and include a boycott of all government associations, which the Moderates opposed
The Moderates demanded an immediate armed uprising across all northern plains
The Extremists sought a complete structural merger of the Congress with the Dharma Sabha
The Moderates completely refused to pass any resolution condemning Lord Curzon's policies
e: Detailed Explanation: At the 1905 Benaras session, the Extremists wanted to extend the Boycott and Swadeshi movement to regions outside Bengal and include a boycott of government service, law courts, and councils. The Moderates opposed this, wanting to restrict the agitation to Bengal and stick strictly to constitutional methods.

qe: At the Calcutta Congress session of December 1906, who was elected as the compromise President to successfully avert an imminent split between the Moderate and Extremist factions?
qh: दिसंबर 1906 के कलकत्ता कांग्रेस सत्र में, नरमपंथी और गरमपंथी गुटों के बीच एक आसन्न विभाजन को सफलतापूर्वक टालने के लिए समझौते के तहत किसे अध्यक्ष चुना गया था?
o: Dadabhai Naoroji
Bal Gangadhar Tilak
Lala Lajpat Rai
Rashbehari Ghosh
e: Detailed Explanation: In the 1906 Calcutta session, the Extremists pushed for Tilak or Lajpat Rai as president, while the Moderates proposed Dadabhai Naoroji. Because Naoroji was universally respected by all nationalists, his election averted a split for the time being.

qe: The word 'Swaraj' was mentioned for the very first time from the official Congress platform during which annual session, defining the goal as self-government similar to the United Kingdom or its colonies?
qh: आधिकारिक कांग्रेस मंच से पहली बार 'स्वराज' शब्द का उल्लेख किस वार्षिक सत्र के दौरान किया गया था, जिसमें लक्ष्य को यूनाइटेड किंगडम या उसके उपनिवेशों के समान स्वशासन के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया था?
o: The Calcutta session of 1906
The Benaras session of 1905
The Surat session of 1907
The Nagpur proposal of 1907
e: Detailed Explanation: The goal of the Congress was defined as 'swarajya or self-government' like the UK or its colonies (Australia/Canada) for the first time at the Calcutta session of 1906 under Dadabhai Naoroji. However, its exact connotation was not spelt out, leaving room for different interpretations.

qe: Why did the Moderate leadership strongly oppose the Extremist program of widespread passive resistance and council boycotts during the run-up to the Surat split?
qh: सूरज विभाजन की तैयारी के दौरान नरमपंथी नेतृत्व ने व्यापक निष्क्रिय प्रतिरोध और परिषद बहिष्कारों के गरमदलीय कार्यक्रम का कड़ा विरोध क्यों किया?
o: They feared that intense anti-imperialist agitation would be ruthlessly suppressed by the mighty colonial forces, and they saw council reforms as an opportunity for participation
They were legally forced by a decree of the Calcutta High Court to dissolve the Congress infrastructure
They completely supported the implementation of separate electorates for different communities
They aimed to entirely replace vernacular education with English-medium military training
e: Detailed Explanation: The Moderates felt that hasty or radical anti-imperialist agitation would invite ruthless state repression and annoy the ruling Liberals in England. They also saw the upcoming council reforms as a genuine opportunity to realize Indian participation in the administration.

qe: The Extremists wanted the historic 1907 Congress session to be held in Nagpur. Why did the Moderates purposefully shift the venue of the session to Surat?
qh: गरमपंथी चाहते थे कि ऐतिहासिक 1907 का कांग्रेस सत्र नागपुर में आयोजित हो। नरमपंथियों ने जानबूझकर इस सत्र के स्थान को सूरत में क्यों स्थानांतरित कर दिया?
o: To exclude Bal Gangadhar Tilak from the presidency, since a leader from the host province could not become the session president
Because Surat possessed a larger network of British managing agencies to fund the session
To completely avoid a severe outbreak of cholera that had paralyzed the Central Provinces
Because the Government had legally banned any political meetings from taking place in Nagpur
e: Detailed Explanation: Under Congress conventions, a leader from the host province could not preside over that session. Since Surat was in Tilak's home province of Bombay, shifting the venue to Surat effectively disqualified him from the presidency, which was a calculated move by the Moderates.

qe: Who was proposed and backed by the Moderates as the President of the split-ridden Surat session of the Indian National Congress in December 1907?
qh: दिसंबर 1907 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के विभाजनकारी सूरत सत्र के अध्यक्ष के रूप में नरमपंथियों द्वारा किसे प्रस्तावित और समर्थित किया गया था?
o: Rashbehari Ghosh
Aurobindo Ghosh
Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Pherozshah Mehta
e: Detailed Explanation: At the Surat session of 1907, the Moderates put forward the name of Rashbehari Ghosh as president and sought to drop the previous resolutions on swadeshi, boycott, and national education, leading to an absolute structural breakdown and split.

qe: Following the Surat split of 1907, the colonial government launched a massive attack on the Extremists. Which of the following sets of repressive laws was brought into force between 1907 and 1911 to check anti-government activity?
qh: 1907 के सूरत विभाजन के बाद, औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने गरमपंथियों पर बड़ा हमला किया। 1907 और 1911 के बीच सरकार विरोधी गतिविधियों को रोकने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दमनकारी कानून लागू किया गया था?
o: Seditious Meetings Act, 1907; Indian Newspapers (Incitement to Offences) Act, 1908; and Indian Press Act, 1910
Vernacular Press Act, 1878; and Licensing Regulations Act, 1823
Age of Consent Act, 1891; and Sarda Act, 1930 structural updates
Sikh Gurudwaras Act, 1922; and the Mahad Water Tank Proclamation codes
e: Detailed Explanation: To suppress the leaderless Extremists after the split, the government passed a series of harsh laws between 1907 and 1911, including the Seditious Meetings Act (1907), the Indian Newspapers Act (1908), the Criminal Law Amendment Act (1908), and the Indian Press Act (1910).

qe: In 1897 and again during his major sedition trial in 1909, Lokmanya Tilak was heavily penalized for articles published in his Marathi journal. What was the name of this newspaper?
qh: 1897 में और फिर 1909 में अपने बड़े राजद्रोह के मुकदमे के दौरान, लोकमान्य तिलक को उनकी मराठी पत्रिका में प्रकाशित लेखों के लिए भारी दंड दिया गया था। इस समाचार पत्र का नाम क्या था?
o: Kesari
Maharatta
Sudharak
Darpan
e: Detailed Explanation: Tilak used his Marathi weekly newspaper 'Kesari' to express bold political views. His editorials about the Muzaffarpur bomb incident led to his arrest and trial for sedition in 1909.

qe: What severe sentence was awarded to Bal Gangadhar Tilak during his 1909 sedition trial, causing countrywide protests and industrial working-class strikes in Bombay?
qh: 1809 के राजद्रोह के मुकदमे के दौरान बाल गंगाधर तिलक को कौन सी गंभीर सजा सुनाई गई थी, जिसके कारण देशव्यापी विरोध प्रदर्शन हुए और बॉम्बे में औद्योगिक मजदूर वर्ग ने हड़ताल की?
o: Six years' transportation and a fine of Rs 1,000 to Mandalay (Burma) jail
Transportation for life to the Cellular Jail in the Andaman Islands
Eighteen months of simple imprisonment inside the Poona local barracks
An absolute dynamic house arrest restricting his movement to the Bombay municipality
e: Detailed Explanation: Tilak was judged guilty of sedition in 1909 and sentenced to six years of transportation and a fine of Rs 1,000. He was sent to the remote fortress prison at Mandalay in Burma, which sparked historic working-class strikes.

qe: The British Secretary of State John Morley implemented a modified three-pronged strategy toward the Indian nationalists. What was the central mechanism of this strategy?
qh: ब्रिटिश राज्य सचिव जॉन मॉर्ले ने भारतीय राष्ट्रवादियों के प्रति एक संशोधित त्रिस्तरीय रणनीति लागू की। इस रणनीति का मुख्य तंत्र क्या था?
o: A strategy of Repression-Conciliation-Suppression designed to isolate the Extremists by placating the Moderates
The complete physical elimination of all intermediate zamindari land revenue collection tiers
A total structural alliance with underground revolutionary outfits to bypass the Congress
The mandatory corporate financing of all newly opened swadeshi textile mills
e: Detailed Explanation: The strategy was designed as 'Carrot and Stick' (Repression-Conciliation-Suppression). The government repressed the Extremists mildly to frighten the Moderates, then placated the Moderates with council reforms to isolate the Extremists. Once isolated, the Extremists were suppressed with full state might, after which the Moderates could be ignored.

qe: In October 1906, a highly influential group of Muslim elites met Viceroy Lord Minto to demand separate electorates. What is this historic event called in modern Indian history?
qh: अक्टूबर 1906 में, मुस्लिम अभिजात वर्ग के एक अत्यधिक प्रभावशाली समूह ने अलग निर्वाचन मंडल (separate electorates) की मांग के लिए वायसराय लॉर्ड मिंटो से मुलाकात की। आधुनिक भारतीय इतिहास में इस ऐतिहासिक घटना को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: The Simla Deputation led by the Agha Khan
The Aligarh Liberal Council led by Sir Syed Ahmed Khan
The Faraizi Revolutionary League led by Dudu Mian
The Dacca Conglomerate organized by Nawab Salimullah
e: Detailed Explanation: In October 1906, a delegation of aristocratic Muslims known as the Simla Deputation, led by the Agha Khan, met Viceroy Minto. They demanded separate electorates for Muslims and political representation in excess of their numerical strength, which laid the groundwork for institutional communal electorates.

qe: The Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, which translated into the Indian Councils Act of 1909, introduced a highly controversial institutional mechanism that deeply damaged national unity. What was this mechanism?
qh: 1909 के मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधारों, जो 1909 के भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम में परिवर्तित हुए, ने एक अत्यधिक विवादास्पद संस्थागत तंत्र पेश किया जिसने राष्ट्रीय एकता को गहरा नुकसान पहुँचाया। यह तंत्र क्या था?
o: The establishment of separate electorates for Muslims for election to the Central Council
The total legal abolition of all native vernacular media publications across presidencies
The absolute non-cooperation framework barring any Indian from entering the civil services
The direct physical takeover of all village community water solutions by British managing agencies
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian Councils Act of 1909 (Morley-Minto Reforms) introduced separate electorates for Muslims for the first time in the central legislative council. This institutionalized communal politics and created deep political barriers that checked the growth of national unity.

qe: Under the modified electoral specifications of the Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, how were the non-official elected members of the legislatures chosen?
qh: 1909 के मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधारों के संशोधित चुनावी विशिष्टताओं के तहत, विधानसभाओं के गैर-आधिकारिक निर्वाचित सदस्यों का चयन कैसे किया जाता था?
o: They were indirectly elected through a multi-tiered system involving local bodies, electoral colleges, and provincial members
They were chosen via an open universal adult franchise tracking system across all provinces
They were handpicked by the executive committee of the All India Kisan Sabha directly
They were selected by running standard competitive examination testing metrics in English
e: Detailed Explanation: The election system under the 1909 Act was highly indirect (described as infiltration through a number of sieves). Local bodies elected an electoral college, which elected provincial legislators, who in turn elected the members of the central Imperial Legislative Council.

qe: Apart from separate electorates, what additional discriminatory electoral privileges were accorded to Muslim voters under the Indian Councils Act of 1909?
qh: पृथक निर्वाचन मंडल के अलावा, भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम 1909 के तहत मुस्लिम मतदाताओं को कौन से अतिरिक्त चुनावी विशेषाधिकार दिए गए थे?
o: Representation in excess of their numerical population strength and lower income qualification thresholds than Hindu voters
The exclusive statutory right to vote on the total annual budget of the Central Council
Complete legal exemption from paying any land revenue or salt taxes across the country
The dynamic right to issue religious decrees (fatwas) against British executive actions
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1909 Reforms granted Muslims representation in excess of their population percentage and kept the income and property qualification threshold for Muslim voters lower than that required for Hindu voters, creating systemic legal disparities.

qe: The Indian Councils Act of 1909 enlarged the functional powers of the legislatures. Which of the following operations were the members now legally authorized to perform?
qh: 1909 के भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम ने विधानसभाओं की कार्यात्मक शक्तियों का विस्तार किया। सदस्यों को अब कानूनी रूप से निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कार्य करने का अधिकार दिया गया था?
o: Pass resolutions, ask questions and supplementaries, and vote on separate items in the budget
Vote upon and amend the imperial budget as a whole package unconditionally
Overturn any executive decision passed by the Viceroy's executive council directly
Appoint provincial lieutenant governors independent of the British Crown's approval
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1909 reforms expanded the powers of the legislative councils by allowing members to ask supplementary questions, move resolutions, and vote on separate items within the budget, although the budget as a whole could still not be voted upon.

qe: Who holds the historic distinction of being appointed as the very first Indian member to the Viceroy’s Executive Council in 1809 under the provisions of the Morley-Minto Reforms?
qh: मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधारों के प्रावधानों के तहत 1909 में वायसराय की कार्यकारी परिषद (Viceroy's Executive Council) में नियुक्त होने वाले पहले भारतीय सदस्य होने का ऐतिहासिक गौरव किसे प्राप्त है?
o: Satyendra Sinha
Rashbehari Ghosh
Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Ananda Mohan Bose
e: Detailed Explanation: Satyendra Prasanna Sinha (S.P. Sinha) was appointed as the Law Member to the Viceroy's Executive Council in 1909, becoming the first Indian to enter this high-level executive administrative body.

qe: During the first World War, Indian nationalist leaders launched the Home Rule Movement. What was the primary objective of this coordinated political alliance?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान, भारतीय राष्ट्रवादी नेताओं ने होम रूल आंदोलन शुरू किया था। इस समन्वित राजनीतिक गठबंधन का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: To demand self-government or home rule for all of India within the British Commonwealth through a year-round national alliance
To organize a nationwide violent armed rebellion to completely overthrow the British Raj immediately
To structurally support the collection of wartime revenue surcharges from landless ryots
To enforce the mandatory implementation of English-only educational curriculum across village panchayats
e: Detailed Explanation: Inspired by the Irish Home Rule League, the Indian Home Rule Movement aimed to establish a year-round national alliance to demand self-government (Home Rule) for India within the British Commonwealth, moving away from the Congress's traditional inactive annual-only session approach.

qe: Instead of a single integrated organization, two separate Home Rule Leagues were launched in 1916. Who were the independent leaders who set them up?
qh: 1916 में एक एकल एकीकृत संगठन के बजाय दो अलग-अलग होम रूल लीग शुरू की गईं। इन्हें स्थापित करने वाले स्वतंत्र नेता कौन थे?
o: Balgangadhar Tilak and Annie Besant
Surendranath Banerjea and Ananda Mohan Bose
Gopal Krishna Gokhale and Mahadeo Govind Ranade
Mohammad Ali Jinnah and Motilal Nehru
e: Detailed Explanation: To avoid organizational friction and smooth out personal group differences, two separate Home Rule Leagues were established in 1916: one by Lokmanya Balgangadhar Tilak and the other by the Irish theosophist Annie Besant.

qe: Which global event during the early 20th century exposed the bare propaganda of Western nations and heavily shook the deep-seated myth of white superiority in the minds of the Indian public?
qh: 20वीं शताब्दी की शुरुआत में किस वैश्विक घटना ने पश्चिमी देशों के नग्न प्रचार को उजागर किया और भारतीय जनता के मन में बैठी श्वेत सर्वोच्चता (white superiority) के गहरे मिथक को हिलाकर रख दिया?
o: The First World War
The Russian Revolution of 1905
The Unification of Germany
The American Civil War
e: Detailed Explanation: The outbreak of the First World War (1914–1918) among major European imperialist powers exposed their raw greed and mutual propaganda, which effectively shattered the long-standing myth of white racial superiority and European cultural benevolence in the minds of colonized peoples.

qe: In April 1916, Balgangadhar Tilak formally launched his Indian Home Rule League. Where did he host his first historic Home Rule meeting?
qh: अप्रैल 1916 में, बालगंगाधर तिलक ने औपचारिक रूप से अपनी इंडियन होम रूल लीग शुरू की। उन्होंने अपनी पहली ऐतिहासिक होम रूल बैठक कहाँ आयोजित की थी?
o: Belgaum
Poona
Bombay city
Nagpur
e: Detailed Explanation: Lokmanya Tilak established his Indian Home Rule League in April 1916 and hosted his first historic campaign meeting at Belgaum, setting up his organizational headquarters at Poona.

qe: What specific territorial jurisdiction was mapped out for Balgangadhar Tilak’s Home Rule League, leaving the remaining parts of India to Annie Besant’s League?
qh: बालगंगाधर तिलक की होम रूल लीग के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट क्षेत्रीय अधिकार क्षेत्र तय किया गया था, जिससे भारत के शेष हिस्से एनी बेसेंट की लीग के लिए बच गए?
o: Maharashtra (excluding Bombay city), Karnataka, Central Provinces, and Berar
The Madras Presidency along with the entire Bengal delta plain
The Punjab province, Sindh subdivision, and Delhi municipality exclusively
Bombay city, Gujarat regions, and the United Provinces zones
e: Detailed Explanation: To prevent overlapping work, Tilak's League operated within a strictly defined territorial zone: Maharashtra (specifically excluding Bombay city), Karnataka, the Central Provinces, and Berar. Annie Besant's League covered the rest of India, including Bombay city.

qe: What distinct demands formed the programmatic baseline of Lokmanya Tilak’s Home Rule League branches during their 1916 organizational tours?
qh: 1916 के संगठनात्मक दौरों के दौरान लोकमान्य तिलक की होम रूल लीग शाखाओं की मांगों का मुख्य आधार क्या था?
o: Swarajya, the formation of linguistic states, and education in the vernacular medium
The immediate and complete abolition of the central Imperial Legislative Council
A total ban on the entry of non-Brahmin intermediate castes into local schools
The direct legal nationalization of all foreign-owned jute and cotton textile mills
e: Detailed Explanation: Tilak's League advanced clear, popular demands that resonated with the masses: the attainment of Swarajya, the administrative reorganization of provinces on a linguistic basis, and providing school education in vernacular languages.

qe: Annie Besant formally established her All-India Home Rule League in September 1916. Which city served as its central core base, and who was appointed its Organizing Secretary?
qh: एनी बेसेंट ने सितंबर 1916 में अपनी ऑल-इंडिया होम रूल लीग की औपचारिक स्थापना की। किस शहर ने इसके केंद्रीय मुख्य आधार के रूप में कार्य किया, और इसके आयोजन सचिव के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया था?
o: Madras, with George Arundale as Organizing Secretary
Bombay, with Mohammad Ali Jinnah as Organizing Secretary
Calcutta, with Ananda Mohan Bose as Organizing Secretary
Lahore, with Lala Lajpat Rai as Organizing Secretary
